name: mantle-host
description: Deploy a Mantle app to Mantle Cloud with one vendored script; Cloudflare and ChatGPT Sites targets get their native step.

interface.shortDescription: Deploy Mantle apps to Mantle Cloud
interface.longDescription: One runtime-neutral deploy tool for three same-level targets: mantle-cloud, cloudflare and chatgpt-sites. It links a project, saves a version from the committed tree, and prints the reviewed deploy and rollback calls. For Cloudflare and ChatGPT Sites it only prints the native step.
defaultPrompt: Link this Mantle app to its Mantle Cloud project with the mantle-host skill
Save a Mantle Cloud version of the committed app, then stop before deploy
Show mantle-host status and the next step for this project
